user1FlowObjectsInputSO.uiInfo: {"label":"User1 Scene Objects", "hint":"SceneObjects which will be enabled for User 1"}

turnsSavedLimitInput.uiInfo: {"label":"Turns Saved Limit", "hint":"Max count of turns saved in turn history. Excess older turns are removed from turn history.", "widget":"spinbox", "min":0, "showIf":"useTurnHistory"}

tappableAreasInput.uiInfo: {"label":"Tappable Areas", "hint":"Only tappable areas with enabled ScreenTransforms and their SceneObjects will be used"}

allowChangingTurnVariablesAfterTurnSubmi.uiInfo: {"hint":"If true turn variables can be changed after turn submission.", "showIf":"requireTurnSubmission", "showIfValue":true}

requireTurnSubmission.uiInfo: {"hint":"If true component will emit onError events in case of submitting or loading incomplete turn data. Call endTurn() to mark turn data as complete"}

user2FlowObjectsInputSO.uiInfo: {"label":"User2 Scene Objects", "hint":"SceneObjects which will be enabled for User 2"}

debugTurnCount.uiInfo: {"label":"Turn Count", "hint":"Turn count for debug. Even numbers for User 1, starting from 0. Odd numbers for User 2, starting from 1.", "widget":"spinbox", "min":0}

autoRestoreTurn.uiInfo: {"hint":"Automatically cache and restore turn data if the user returns to the lens without sharing the snap\nMake sure to handle restored data correctly in your lens logic to prevent updating turn data multiple times per turn."}

gameOverObjectsInputSO.uiInfo: {"label":"Game Over Scene Objects", "hint":"SceneObjects which will be enabled when game ends", "showIf":"requireTurnSubmission"}

useTextDisplay.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Display Name Text", "hint":"Enables the use of a text display for the target user's display name."}

useBitmojiSticker.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Bitmoji Sticker", "hint":"Enables the use of a Bitmoji sticker texture for the target user."}

useBitmoji3D.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Bitmoji 3D", "hint":"Enables the use of a Bitmoji 3D avatar for the target user."}

fallbackText.uiInfo: {"hint":"This text will be displayed when the targeted user is not available (e.g., the target user hasn't joined the session yet)."}

text.uiInfo: {"hint":"The Text component to apply text to. If not set, it will try to find one on the SceneObject if available.", "showIf":"targetType", "showIfValue":"Text"}

text3D.uiInfo: {"label":"Text3D", "hint":"The Text3D component to apply text to. If not set, it will try to find one on the SceneObject if available.", "showIf":"targetType", "showIfValue":"Text3D"}

targetType.uiInfo: {"label":"Text Type", "hint":"Select the type of text component to apply text to.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Text", "value":"Text"}, {"label":"Text3D", "value":"Text3D"}]}

configurableSetTextInputs.uiInfo: {"label":"Text Target", "hint":"Setting for applying the user's display name to a text component."}

textDisplayConfigInputs.uiInfo: {"label":"Text Display Settings", "hint":"Settings for the text display of the target user's display name.", "showIf":"useTextDisplay"}

type.uiInfo:
{"label":"User Type", "hint":"Choose a type of user.
* 'Current User' will return the current user.
* 'Other User' will return the other user in the session.
* 'User 1' will return the first user to join the session.
* 'User 2' will return the second user to join the session.
* 'None' will not return any user.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Current User", "value":"Current"}, {"label":"Other User", "value":"Other"}, {"label":"User 1", "value":"User1"}, {"label":"User 2", "value":"User2"}, {"label":"None", "value":"None"}]}

targetUser.uiInfo: {"hint":"Determines which user is displayed through this component."}

hideBitmoji3DIfNotFound.uiInfo: {"label":"Hide Avatar If Not Found", "hint":"If true, the Bitmoji 3D avatar's SceneObject will be disabled if the user is not found."}

bitmojiComponent.uiInfo: {"label":"Bitmoji 3D", "hint":"The Bitmoji 3D component that manages the Bitmoji 3D avatar. Import the Bitmoji 3D component from the Asset Library, add it to the scene, and set it here."}

autoLoadBitmoji3D.uiInfo: {"label":"Auto Load", "hint":"Automatically loads the Bitmoji 3D avatar for the user when the component is initialized. If false, you must load it manually through component API."}

stickerId.uiInfo: {"label":"Sticker ID", "hint":"The specific Bitmoji sticker ID to use. If left empty, the default selfie will be used. See instructions below for how to find a sticker ID.", "showIf":"stickerType", "showIfValue":"StickerID"}

placeholderTexture.uiInfo: {"hint":"Texture to use before any user is loaded. If not set, no texture will be applied."}

missingUserTexture.uiInfo: {"hint":"Texture to use if there is no user available to load a Bitmoji sticker for. If not set, no texture will be applied."}

loadingTexture.uiInfo: {"hint":"Texture to use while the Bitmoji sticker is loading. If not set, no texture will be applied."}

fallbackSettings.uiInfo: {"label":"Placeholder Textures", "hint":"Settings for placeholder and fallback textures to use while loading or if no user is available."}

autoLoad.uiInfo: {"hint":"Automatically loads the Bitmoji sticker when the user becomes available. If false, you must load it manually through component API."}

stickerType.uiInfo: {"hint":"The Bitmoji sticker type to use. Selfie will show the default Bitmoji selfie, while Sticker ID will use a specific sticker ID.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Selfie", "value":"Selfie"}, {"label":"Sticker ID", "value":"StickerID"}]}

meshVisualMaterialIndex.uiInfo: {"label":"Material Index", "hint":"The index of the material in the MeshVisual's materials array to apply the texture to. Defaults to 0 (the first material).\n\nNOTE: This is ignored when Output Type is set to Material.", "showIf":"showAdvancedOptions"}

showAdvancedOptions.uiInfo: {"hint":"Controls whether advanced options are shown. Note that these settings will always be used, even if this is disabled and they are not visible in the UI."}

outputType.uiInfo:
{"hint":"The type of output to apply the texture to.
* None: No action will be taken.
* Image: Applies the texture to an Image component.
* MeshVisual: Applies the texture to a MaterialMeshVisual component.
* Material: Applies the texture to a Material asset.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":"None"}, {"label":"Image", "value":"Image"}, {"label":"MeshVisual", "value":"MeshVisual"}, {"label":"Material", "value":"Material"}]}

image.uiInfo: {"hint":"The Image component to apply the texture to.", "showIf":"outputType", "showIfValue":"Image"}

material.uiInfo: {"hint":"The Material to apply the texture to.", "showIf":"outputType", "showIfValue":"Material"}

meshVisualCloneType.uiInfo:
{"label":"Material Cloning", "hint":"Controls how a MeshVisual's material is cloned or overridden when applying the texture.
* None: No cloning, uses the original material.
* Use Overrides: Uses the mainPassOverrides of the MaterialMeshVisual.
* Clone: Clones the MeshVisual's mainMaterial and reapplies it as the first material.
* Clone Once: Clones the mainMaterial only once, subsequent calls will continue using the cloned material.

NOTE: This is ignored when Output Type is set to Material.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":"None"}, {"label":"Use Overrides", "value":"Override"}, {"label":"Clone", "value":"Clone"}, {"label":"Clone Once", "value":"CloneOnce"}], "showIf":"showAdvancedOptions"}

meshVisual.uiInfo: {"hint":"The MaterialMeshVisual component to apply the texture to.", "showIf":"outputType", "showIfValue":"MeshVisual"}

materialPropertyName.uiInfo: {"label":"Property Name", "hint":"The name of the material property to apply the texture to. This is typically 'baseTex' for the base texture, but can be any valid property name on the Material's mainPass.", "showIf":"showAdvancedOptions"}

applyActionInputs.uiInfo: {"label":"Apply Sticker To:", "hint":"Settings for applying the Bitmoji sticker texture to a specific component or material."}

bitmojiStickerConfigInputs.uiInfo: {"label":"Bitmoji Sticker Settings", "hint":"Settings for the Bitmoji sticker.", "showIf":"useBitmojiSticker"}

turnBased.uiInfo:
{"label":"Turn Based Component", "hint":"The Turn Based component that manages the turn-based session.

1. If not already installed, import the Turn Based component from the Asset Library.

2. Make sure the Turn Based component is added to your project.

3. Make sure a Turn Based component is present in the scene.

4. Set the reference to the Turn Based component here."}

properties.name: Turn Based Player Info

shapeTexturePool.uiInfo: {"hint":"Parallel array to shapeVerticesPool — the art texture applied to shapeObject's Image component for each shape."}

shapeVerticesPool.uiInfo: {"hint":"Pool of shapes — one JSON vertex-array string per entry (e.g. your 50 shapes). Takes priority over shapeVertices above when init() is called with an index."}

strokeFraction.uiInfo: {"hint":"stroke width / canvas size used when generating the shape art, e.g. 28px stroke on a 1024px canvas = 28/1024"}

failToleranceMultiplier.uiInfo: {"hint":"How many multiples of edgeTolerance the needle can drift before it counts as going off the shape entirely (used for the lives system)."}

padding.uiInfo: {"hint":"1.0 = fills the smaller side exactly, 0.9 = 90% with a margin"}

testShapeIndex.uiInfo: {"hint":"TESTING ONLY — when forceStandaloneTest is on, set this to a specific index in shapeVerticesPool (e.g. 10 for rocket) to always load THAT shape instead of a random one. Leave at -1 for random."}

failGraceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Brief invulnerability window right after losing a life, giving the player a moment to steer back onto the line before fail-detection resumes."}

lifeLostPopup.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — a script on your popup SceneObject exposing show(livesRemaining). GameController just triggers it; the popup handles its own animation/auto-hide timing."}

forceStandaloneTest.uiInfo: {"hint":"TESTING ONLY — force-starts a round on launch even when a TurnController is wired in, so you can iterate in Lens Studio Preview without a live paired match. Turn this OFF before publishing."}

failDebounceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"How long the needle must stay outside failTolerance before it counts as going off the shape (prevents one noisy touch sample from costing a life)."}

fadeInDuration.uiInfo: {"hint":"How long the fade-in itself takes once the stall threshold is reached."}

dotSizeMultiplier.uiInfo: {"hint":"Dot diameter as a multiple of edgeTolerance (the shape's stroke half-width), so dots visually match the line thickness at any screen size or shape."}

stallSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"How long the player can go without tracing a new segment before the dim markers start fading in."}

pendingDotAlpha.uiInfo: {"hint":"Opacity the dim \"missing segment\" markers fade in to once the player seems stuck. Set to 0 to disable the feature entirely."}

tipMarker.uiInfo: {"hint":"REQUIRED for accurate calibration. Add an empty SceneObject with a Screen Transform, position it EXACTLY on the needle's visual tip in the editor (independent of any shape), and assign it here. This replaces calibrating against a shape's first vertex, which broke once shapes had different first-vertex positions."}

fullScreenTransform.uiInfo: {"hint":"A ScreenTransform whose anchors span the ENTIRE screen (-1,-1 to 1,1) — e.g. a full-screen background or root canvas object. Used to correctly convert raw touch coordinates into world space regardless of how deeply the needle is nested."}

turnFlowScreens.uiInfo: {"hint":"Script exposing showTurnComplete(payload), hideTurnComplete(), and showMatchOver(outcome, payload). See TurnFlowScreens.js."}

turnBased.uiInfo: {"hint":"The Turn Based custom component (TurnBased.lsc). Configure on IT directly, in its own Inspector: Require Turn Submission = true, Use Turn Limit = true with an EVEN Turn Limit, and Game Over Scene Objects."}

timerController.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — TimerController.js driving the live 'Trace the Shape · 0:0X' stopwatch. Started at turn start, stopped once the turn ends."}

roundText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — shows 'Round N' (or 'Round N / M' if the Turn Based component's own Turn Limit is set). A round is 2 turns — one per player on the same shape."}

opponentScoreText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — the other player's last-known cumulative score, for competitive context."}

startingLives.uiInfo: {"hint":"Fresh lives granted at the start of EVERY turn — lives do NOT persist between turns, only the score does."}

myLivesText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — hearts for the lives remaining on the CURRENT shape attempt."}

winHeaderText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — e.g. '<Winner> Wins!'. This screen is what gets captured and sent as the Snap, so the text should read correctly for whoever views it, not just the player whose device is showing it."}

turnCompleteSuccessArt.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — shown instead of turnCompleteFailArt when payload.success is true."}

turnCompleteScoreText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — 'Your score: X' summary. On a successful trace, also appends the time it took and, once the other player has also traced this round's shape, whether you were faster."}

turnCompleteHeaderText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — e.g. 'Shape traced!' / 'Out of lives!' depending on payload.success."}

turnCompleteFailArt.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — shown instead of turnCompleteSuccessArt when payload.success is false."}

matchOverTimeText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — e.g. 'Abdul 12.4s  ·  Sam 18.1s', each player's cumulative time across all their successful traces this match."}

loseHeaderText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional — same '<Winner> Wins!' text as winHeaderText (the winner's name doesn't change based on which device is showing it)."}

turnCompleteRoot.uiInfo: {"hint":"Shown right after you finish (or run out of lives on) your shape, just before the Snap is captured and sent."}
